description: On a nine-storey apartment with sixty dwellings, rated CLT walls form part of the encapsulated mass timber structure. Electrical outlet boxes on opposite sides of one wall would be only 250 mm apart. We want to keep that spacing and submit a local protection detail instead of moving the boxes.
